What is Predis.ai?

Social media content generator that produces complete posts - carousel, image and video creatives plus captions and hashtags - from a short text prompt or a product URL, and schedules them directly to connected accounts.

Best for

Generating and scheduling complete social posts at volume for small teams.

Main features

  • Generate carousels, single-image posts, reels and video ads from a text prompt or product URL
  • caption and hashtag generation tuned per platform
  • competitor analysis showing what works for rival accounts
  • content calendar and direct scheduling to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, Pinterest and YouTube
  • brand kit for fonts, colours and logos
  • bulk generation and CSV import
  • e-commerce product-to-post from Shopify or a URL
  • white-label option for agencies.

Practical use cases

  • Generating a month of Instagram carousels from a product catalogue
  • turning a Shopify product page into a ready-to-post ad creative
  • maintaining posting consistency across several platforms without a designer
  • analysing a competitor's social performance
  • white-labelled social delivery for agency clients.

Who is it for?

  • Small businesses, e-commerce brands, social media managers and agencies managing multiple client accounts.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium credit-based subscription by posts and accounts

Plans described in the source

Free $0 with roughly 15 AI-generated posts per month and 1 social account. Lite around $32/mo ($27 annually) with roughly 60 posts/month and more accounts. Premium around $59-67/mo ($50-55 annually) with roughly 120-200 posts and multiple brands. Agency/Ultimate tiers around $119-249/mo with many brands, white-labelling and team seats. Annual billing roughly 15-20% cheaper.

Free plan

Yes - free tier with roughly 15 posts/month and 1 connected account, enough for genuine evaluation.

Free trial

Free tier serves as the trial.

Usage limits to consider

Metered by AI-generated posts per month plus the number of connected social accounts and brand workspaces. Video generation consumes more allowance than static posts.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • End-to-end from prompt to scheduled post is genuinely complete - most competitors do either creative or scheduling, not both
  • the product-URL-to-post flow is excellent for e-commerce
  • white-labelling makes it viable as an agency delivery tool
  • free tier is usable enough to evaluate properly
  • very good value at the Lite tier.

Limitations to consider

  • Creative quality is template-driven and clearly below what a designer produces - fine for volume, not for brand-defining work
  • carousel designs repeat across users
  • video generation is basic
  • smaller company with thinner support
  • analytics are shallow compared with dedicated social tools like Sprout or Later
  • brand kit controls are limited.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web
  • mobile-responsive
  • Chrome extension

Languages

  • Content generation in multiple languages including Arabic and French

API access

Yes - API available on higher tiers for programmatic generation

Integrations and exports

  • Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, Pinterest, YouTube, Google Business Profile, Shopify, WooCommerce, Zapier

Evaluation notes

Best value in this marketing group for a small e-commerce business that needs consistent posting volume. For brand-critical creative, generate in Predis and refine in Canva rather than posting raw output.
